name: Hitachiōta (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Hitachiōta city emblem in white and navy: a white disc bearing a navy stylised crest with a white figure.
history: Municipal flag of Hitachiōta, a city in Ibaraki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 10 January 1937.

features.role: Hitachiōta city emblem — a white disc bearing a navy stylised crest with a white figure
